name: Ludia
personality: A romance-loving academy graduate who writes fiction, admires art, and enjoys shopping.
story: Daughter of a renowned soldier, she trained in swordsmanship and etiquette at an elite academy and, as of 1449, works for Talimun's Vandahl Trading. Recruitment requires a quest at Callianeira Port.

personalSkill.name: Falcon
personalSkill.effect: If unit attacks first, grants AS+3 during combat. Lv 20: Perception (Avo+10 when she can follow up); Lv 35: Perception+ (Avo+20).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (speedster). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

why: Support 3 and Renown 7 tie with Theodora. Neither lord has a support with Ludia, so roster balance decided it.
recruit.tip: Recruit late Ch 8 or Ch 9 week 1, as soon as Renown 7 lands: about Lv 15 in a Beginner class.

path: Hunter (late Ch 8 or Ch 9 join, bench)
build.notes: Bench in Part I: Guzran holds the sword striker slot. She joins late Ch 8 or Ch 9 week 1 at about Lv 15, levels in dungeon parties, takes Myrmidon at Lv 20 and masters Ravaging Arts before Part II. Shido on Part II Ch 2's License at Lv 35.

guide.summary: Part II depth: she joins late Ch 8 or Ch 9 week 1 and levels in dungeon parties through Part I. Falcon (AS +3 when she attacks first) and Perception (Avo +10/+20 when she can follow up) mean she doubles and dodges on her own turn, so pick off isolated foes and pull back. In Part II she becomes Leda's fourth Dance target as a [[class:Shido]].
guide.playstyle: Player phase only: attack first, double, dodge the counter. Never end in range of mages or several archers.
keys: Gift her, then seat Leda + Ludia + Halvin from Ch 4: Support 3 by late Ch 8
Recruit late Ch 8 or Ch 9 week 1 (Renown 7, short quest): about Lv 15
Hunter to Lv 20, then [[class:Myrmidon]] in Ch 9 (Sword C)
EXP: a dungeon seat every week in Ch 9's caves; aim at Lv 30? by Ch 12
Hold Wooden Sword +5, Killing Edge, Charm, Flyssa, Cleansing Blade, Concoction at 11/27
Part II: Myrmidon in Ch 1, [[class:Shido]] on Ch 2's free License (Lv 35)
watch: Weight: Iron Sword +4 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 6, no Spd from the sword. Falcon AS +3 when she attacks first
Res: growth 20, 15 as a Shido; one mage can kill her
Str 35: she kills with crits and doubles, not single hits
Ravaging Arts: master it in Part I dungeon fights, or Shido waits a map

guide.alt: Deploy her over Guzran only if he falls far behind the core: same role, Spd 70 as a Myrmidon against his Str 45. Ranger (carried in) adds bows and Countershot if you need another archer.

routeNotes.note: Buccar, Esmeralda and Fianna in this army; Seteth if recruited. Before she joins: Leda + Ludia + Halvin. After: Fianna + Esmeralda + Ludia.
Her Part II kit comes from dance trips: buy the second Killing Edge in Regia (by 5/28) and the second Flyssa in Zoste (Ch 6). Guzran uses the first pair.
Part II Dance target 4: Falcon and Perception only work on her own attacks, and Special Dance's Spd +3 locks in the double.

decisions.why: Every level from Lv 15 grows Hunter and Myrmidon rows, Ravaging Arts is mastered before Part II, and the Arena gets 15+ weeks for Sword B. Unrecruited units auto-level on personal growths only.

decisions.pick: Guzran holds the sword striker slot in Part I
decisions.why: He joins in Ch 5 and grows Str 45 to her 35; he rates higher on all three lists. She takes the fourth Dance in Part II instead.

decisions.pick: Wooden Sword +5 in hand; Killing Edge for Deadly Blade turns
decisions.why: Mt 17 at Wt 2 beats the Killing Edge's Mt 11 at Wt 6: Mt +6 and AS +4 on a doubler. Common ore only; the route's Killing Edge refine is Guzran's. Part III +9 adds Spd +5.
